title: poissonia hypoleuca
intro: Poissonia hypoleuca, commonly known as the "Yellow Bells" plant, is a type of flowering plant native to Central America. The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including the treatment of fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Poissonia hypoleuca are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties, which help to reduce inflammation and facilitate the removal of mucus from the airways. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been shown to exhibit antioxidant and antimicrobial activities.
